Engineer class gains advantage on maintenance and upgrade actions

power_integration: Force powers can enhance exploration and social actions
Tech powers can improve maintenance and upgrade actions
Powers can provide additional narrative outcomes
Force users can sense hidden locations or threats
Tech users can optimize ship systems beyond normal limits

Rebel Alliance training provides bonus to stealth and exploration actions
Mandalorian training provides bonus to combat and maintenance actions
Smuggler training provides bonus to trade and stealth actions
Jedi training provides bonus to Force-enhanced actions
